_note: Creatures of the realm (docs/PLAYER_SYSTEMS.md §3, §10.1: new canon, approved). health and damage are per hit before armour; damage_type cut|pierce|blunt|fire; resist is the fraction of each type shrugged off (negative = weak to it). behaviour: stalk (close in slowly, strike in reach), charge (rush in, strike, fall back, rush again), flee_when_hurt (run below flee_below of health). where: the locations it lives in, how many appear and how often (chance per visit). drops: item ids left when it dies

creatures.name: Wolf
creatures.description: Grey Darkwood wolves, lean after the bad years. They hunt in twos and threes and test a traveller before they commit.

creatures.name: Wild boar
creatures.description: A Darkwood boar, heavy in the shoulder, with tusks that open a man's leg. It charges when cornered and keeps charging.

creatures.name: Adder
creatures.description: A ridge adder sunning on the warm stones of the smugglers' trail. It strikes only what comes too close, and its bite festers.

creatures.name: Rat
creatures.description: Pit and Warrens rats, bold from living beside people who cannot afford to chase them off.

creatures.name: Brown bear
creatures.description: A rare brown bear from high on the ridge, seen once in a few years. Most who meet one live because they backed away.
